$comment: Every outbound network destination of the published @brandsystem/mcp package (local stdio server + CLI; dist/hosted is excluded from the package). Enforced by test/security/egress-allowlist.test.ts: any hard-coded http(s)/ws(s) host in src/ or the built dist/ that is not listed here (or explicitly ignored, with a reason, in that test) fails CI. docs/DATA-FLOWS.md is generated from this file: run `node scripts/render-data-flows.mjs --write` after editing it.

destinations.name: Sources you point a tool at
destinations.dynamic_hosts: Any http(s) URL you pass to a tool (website, page list, logo URL), plus same-site stylesheets, sitemap.xml, common logo paths and pages linked from it.
destinations.when: Only when you call one of these tools with a URL. Rendered extraction launches your local Chrome with this package's loopback egress proxy as its only network path.
destinations.data_sent: Plain GET/HEAD requests with a `brandsystem-mcp/<version>` (or headless Chrome) User-Agent. No cookies, credentials, or local brand data. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are refused (SSRF guard, re-checked on every redirect and every browser connection).
destinations.disable: Don't pass URLs; use brand_extract_pdf / brand_extract_figma / brand_set_logo with inline SVG or data_uri instead.

destinations.name: Logo fallback services (Clearbit, Google favicons)
destinations.when: During web extraction, only if no usable logo was found on the site itself. Clearbit is tried first; the Google favicon service is the last resort.
destinations.data_sent: The domain of the site being extracted (in the request URL) and a `brandsystem-mcp/<version>` User-Agent. Nothing else.
destinations.disable: No switch yet. Avoid it by giving brand_extract_web a `logo_url`, or set the logo afterwards with brand_set_logo (inline SVG or data_uri) and skip web extraction.

destinations.name: Firecrawl rendering API
destinations.when: Only when the FIRECRAWL_API_KEY environment variable is set; used instead of a direct fetch to render JavaScript-heavy sites.
destinations.data_sent: The URL you asked to extract, plus your FIRECRAWL_API_KEY as a bearer token.

destinations.name: Brandcode Studio connector
destinations.when: Only when you call a connector tool, or — after you turn on Live Mode with brand_brandcode_live — when brand_status, brand_check, brand_check_compliance, brand_runtime, brand_preview or brand_audit_content refresh an expired cached package. Additional Studio origins (staging, self-hosted, localhost) are trusted only if you list them in BRANDCODE_STUDIO_TRUSTED_ORIGINS. A brand URL on any other (custom) domain is read only as a public package: https only, through the SSRF guard, with no credentials.
destinations.data_sent: Brand slug and share token (pull); email address (sign-in: magic link / device code); session token; the compiled brand package (push/save); repo owner/name, branch and path (repo connect). Credentials are sent only to trusted Studio origins, and never to a different origin (redirects included).
destinations.disable: Don't call the connector tools and leave Live Mode off (the default). `brand_brandcode_live mode="off"` stops background refreshes.

destinations.name: brand_feedback reports
destinations.when: Only when brand_feedback is called. It also retries earlier reports in ~/.brandsystem/feedback/ that never reached the server. Not registered in the default `core` tool profile.
destinations.data_sent: The feedback item: category, severity, summary/detail text (sanitized), tool name, error context; for `agent_signal` items also the brand's client_name, session number and schema version from .brand/brand.config.yaml. Saved locally first.
destinations.disable: Use the default `core` profile (BRANDSYSTEM_PROFILE unset or `core`), or don't call brand_feedback. brand_feedback_review and brand_feedback_triage are local-only.

destinations.name: Anonymous usage telemetry
destinations.when: Only when BRANDSYSTEM_TELEMETRY is `true`, `1` or `yes`. Off by default.
destinations.data_sent: Tool name, success/error code, duration, extraction-quality grade, session number, package version, a random per-process session id, and the MCP_CLIENT env value. No brand content, URLs, file paths, or user data.

destinations.name: Hosted MCP entry (not used by the local server)
tools: none — dist/index-http.js is the hosted Brandcode MCP adapter
destinations.when: Never by `brandsystem-mcp` / `npx @brandsystem/mcp`. The file ships in dist/ but its hosted router (dist/hosted) is excluded from the package, so it cannot start from an installed copy.
